text:
noah: quick ping — during ember-v1 q4 onboarding I noticed ellipsis/period insertion around Arabic phrases when combined with Chinese ellipses. Looks like quant-only.

noah: repro (canary ember-v1.q4):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/canary/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"ember-v1.q4","input":"\u4eca\u5929\u7684\u60ca\u559c... \u0627\u0644\u0627\u062a\u062c\u0627\u0621"}'
```

noah: expected: \u4eca\u5929\u7684\u60ca\u559c... \u0627\u0644\u0627\u062a\u062c\u0627\u0621
observed: \u4eca\u5929\u7684\u60ca\u559c. . . \u0627\u0644\u0627\u062a\u062c\u0627\u0621  <-- periods separated by spaces inserted before RTL run

ami: interesting. can you paste tokenizer + bidi classes? curious if ellipsis is tokenized as three dots or single U+2026.

noah: token dump from canary q4 run:
```
tokens: ["\u4eca\u5929","\u7684","\u60ca\u559c","..."," ","\u0627\u0644\u0627\u062a\u062c\u0627\u0621"]
bidi: [LTR,LTR,LTR,ON,WS,RTL]
```

noah: tokenizer emits ON for ellipsis; q4 path appears to split it into three separate '.' tokens when mapping kvcache indices, then spacing logic adds spaces before the RTL run. int8/fp16 fine.

reza: recent q4 packing change optimized short-run packing by splitting multi-char neutral tokens into bytes for alignment. sounds like that could surface here. starting bisect across q4 kernel patches.

ysun: add locale set "zh-ar-ellipsis" (500 ex). l10n-bot: baseline eval: ember-v1.fp16 BLEU 7.0; ember-v1.q4 BLEU 4.2; ember-v1.int8 BLEU 6.9. Fails saved to /datasets/locale-onboard/zh-ar-ellipsis/fails-2987654321.json

ami: short-term mitigation: add a routing rule in canary to prefer int8/FP16 for requests with CJK + strong RTL neutral punctuation. low-risk and avoids user-facing regressions.

deploy-bot: Bisect job started by reza (job-8801). ETA ~30m.

reza: bisect narrowed to commit 9f4a..b2c8 which contains neutral-token packing change. building q4 variant with multi-char neutrals preserved.

noah: please also add unit tests for U+2026 and mixed '.' sequences around RTL runs; edge-case in detokenization.

deploy-bot: Canary build ember-v1.q4-hotfix deployed. Locale regression zh-ar-ellipsis: q4-hotfix BLEU 6.8 (fp16 7.0). sample check: ellipsis preserved as U+2026 and no extra spaces.

amI: PR #4510 opened with hotfix and tests. assign @reza and @ysun for review. leaving canary monitor for 72h.

noah: thanks all. saved failing examples to /tmp/ember-q4-zh-ar-ellipsis-fails.json, will escalate if drift.
